expanded_forms.meaning: CommSemiring coefficients; size 0=0; subadditive and submultiplicative real coefficient size, not necessarily nonnegative or multiplicative.

modern_rows: Coefficient size can be supplied through standard seminorm/absolute-value classes instead of ad hoc scalar assumptions; packaging remains design work.
Finite algebraic sums; filters and topology are unnecessary.
No constructed universal object in this inequality.
The fresh compiled expanded coefficient form uses CommSemiring, not integers or fields; only zero, subadditivity and submultiplicativity of size are needed.
Exponent σ→₀ℕ is already arbitrary in σ. Additive monoid convolution is a broader standard candidate; its size inequality is not claimed compiled here.
After mul_def, proof is a double finite triangle bound and scalar product size. P,Q occur only through coefficients/support. GenericMul verifies scalar abstraction.
False-generalization guard: preserve coefficient L1 sum and convolution product. Pointwise multiplication, supremum/Gauss norms, field norm and integrated polynomial L1 are distinct quantities.
strategy_rows: Element coefficients are appropriate; ideal inclusions do not express the estimate.
Universal properties do not remove the norm estimate.
A generic coefficient-size convolution bound would replace the double support expansion; triangle/finite-size helpers in this experiment are newly proved, not existing mathlib.

Existing theorem universe-polymorphic in σ; no new structure universe constraints.
